name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: Aromatic slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemons, olives, and warm spices in a traditional tagine.
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and season with salt, pepper, and spices.
Brown chicken pieces in a tagine or heavy pot with olive oil.
Add sliced onions and cook until softened.
Add ginger, saffron, and cinnamon stick.
Add enough water to barely cover chicken.
Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours until chicken is tender.
Add preserved lemons and olives in the last 15 minutes.
Serve with couscous or flatbread.

name: Korean BBQ Bulgogi
description: Tender marinated beef grilled to perfection with Korean flavors and served with rice.
instructions: Slice beef very thinly against the grain.
Grate Asian pear and mix with soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil.
Add minced garlic and chopped green onions to marinade.
Marinate beef for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Grill beef on high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve immediately with steamed rice and kimchi.
Garnish with sesame seeds and extra green onions.

name: Italian Risotto Milanese
description: Creamy saffron risotto with Parmesan cheese, a classic from Northern Italy.
instructions: Heat chicken stock and keep warm. Steep saffron in 2 tbsp hot stock.
Sauté finely chopped onion in 2 tbsp butter until translucent.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until grains are coated.
Add wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy but still al dente.
Stir in saffron mixture, remaining butter, and Parmesan.
Serve immediately while hot and creamy.
